summary: The Snooze presets are editable on the desktop and shared with the phones. The backend that owns the chats stores the list as settings row chats.snoozePresets, a JSON array of SnoozePresetSpec (time of day with dayOffset 0 or 1, weekday and time, or duration in minutes), from 1 to 8 in list order. A read goes through parsePresetList, so a missing row, a row that is not JSON or a list with nothing usable reads as the four defaults and an invalid entry is dropped. A write goes through checkPresetList and is refused whole with a reason (not_a_list, empty, too_many, invalid_preset with its index); the stored list is the parsed one, labels trimmed and other fields dropped, and a write that changed it is broadcast on app:snooze-presets-changed to every client. Channels app:get-snooze-presets and app:set-snooze-presets, open to a phone's chat scope like the other Snooze channels; capability chat_snooze_presets_v1. settings:set of the row takes the same check and broadcast (a refused write throws its reason), and settings:remove brings the defaults back with a broadcast. The resolution rules are unchanged (resolvePresets: soonest first, one item per minute, the higher preset in the list wins a tie); presetTiming exposes when a preset would wake and why the menu leaves it out, for the editor. Desktop: Settings > General > Snooze presets edits the list (label, a kind radio group, Today or Tomorrow, a Monday-first weekday group, a time field, an amount with Minutes, Hours or Days, Next with a DST note, Move up and down, Remove with an inline Undo, Add up to 8, Reset to defaults through confirm, save on blur or pick, errors after blur with aria-invalid and aria-describedby, a reason for a preset the menu leaves out now, a status line and a menu preview). The row menu, the narrow ... menu, the context submenu and the palette resolve this desktop's backend list when they open (also for a chat on a remote machine; every device resolves the times in its own zone). Phones: the Expo app and native Android read the list from a backend with chat_snooze_presets_v1, follow the broadcast, and resolve it in the Snooze sheet, frozen when the sheet opens; an older backend keeps the defaults. Phones cannot edit the list in this release. Desktop analytics are unchanged: the Worker has no snooze_presets_saved event, so none is sent; a snooze from a preset that is not a default already reports kind preset.

automated: tests/unit/snooze-presets-backend.test.ts (real SQLite): a read with no row, a row that is not JSON or a list with nothing usable is the defaults, and an invalid entry is dropped; a write stores the checked list trimmed and without other fields and broadcasts it once; a write equal to the stored list does not broadcast; not a list, empty, 9 entries and an invalid entry are refused with their reason and keep the stored list; 40 characters, 5 minutes and 365 days are accepted and 41 characters, 4 minutes and 365 days plus a minute are not; app:get-snooze-presets and app:set-snooze-presets through registerAppHandlers; settings:set of the row refuses with the same reason and settings:remove brings the defaults back, each with a broadcast; BACKEND_CAPABILITIES lists chat_snooze_presets_v1.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-rules.test.ts with tests/fixtures/chat-snooze-cases.json: presetsDst runs resolvePresets in a child process with TZ America/New_York (a tomorrow 02:30 on 14 March 2027 moves to 03:30 EDT, a weekday 02:30 the same and the same-minute time below it is hidden, 01:30 on 1 November 2026 takes the first occurrence, a one-day duration is 24 hours and ends at 11:00 EST, and near midnight a today 23:45 shows, a today 23:30 exactly an hour away hides and a tomorrow 00:15 is tomorrow); presetList runs parsePresetList (drops invalid entries, trims, keeps 8, defaults for an empty list, nothing usable, not a list and a missing setting).

tests/unit/snooze-presets-panel.test.ts (jsdom): accessible names and the menu preview at a fixed clock; a label saves on blur only, with the not-saved line before blur, Saving until the backend answers and Saved after; a bad time shows no error before blur, then aria-invalid, aria-describedby to the message and the keep-the-saved line, and the list is not sent; label and duration limits; an edit still in its field saves when Settings closes; the kind, day and weekday radio groups with ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home and End keep focus on the option and save each pick; Remove focuses the next label and Undo puts the row back at its place and focuses its label; removing the last row focuses Add and the only row cannot be removed; Move keeps focus on its button; Add stops at 8 with aria-disabled and the reason, and a row with no label is not sent; Reset only after the confirm dialog's Reset presets; the hidden and same-minute lines; a list another client saved replaces the rows, and a refused save names the reason. The store test: a read, a broadcast that beats a read still out, an unusable broadcast reads as the defaults.

tests/unit/sidebar-snooze-rows.test.ts: the row menu resolves the stored presets when it opens and shows a changed list on the next open; tests/unit/command-palette-routing.test.ts: the palette lists the stored presets soonest first with their times. tests/unit/snooze-presets-contrast.test.ts: the row text, errors, warnings, chips, notice, status line and preview read at 4.5:1 or better in dark and light.

e2e/visual-regressions.e2e.mjs: settings-snooze-presets and settings-snooze-preview baselines in dark, light and translucent, and the settings baseline with the section under Sidebar; no other baseline changed.

apps/mobile jest: stores/__tests__/recents-presets.test.ts (a refresh reads the presets from a backend with the capability and not from one without, whose sheet keeps the defaults; a broadcast replaces the list, an unusable one reads as the defaults, unpairing forgets it; the sheet resolves the machine list soonest first with the PR item last); recents-woke.test.ts and tests/unit/mobile-recents-store.test.ts keep passing; tsc --noEmit clean.

apps/android gradle testDebugUnitTest: ChatSnoozeFixturesTest runs the presetsDst cases in America/New_York, the presetList and parsePreset cases and the broadcast payload; HomeSnoozePresetsTest checks the sheet with a machine list and the defaults for a machine never read.
notExercised: Neither phone was run on a device or a simulator: reading the list behind chat_snooze_presets_v1, following the broadcast and the sheet with custom presets are covered by unit tests only.
The Settings editor was checked in jsdom and in the packaged screenshot run at its default state; a session on a real desktop that edits presets while a phone is connected was not run.
A desktop connected to a remote machine resolves its own backend's list for that machine's chats; the remote backend's own list is used only by phones paired with it. Not run against a real remote.
VoiceOver and other screen readers were not run on the editor; the names, roles and live announcements are checked in the DOM only.
